name: gatekeeper
description: OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect identity provider — PKCE, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, TOTP MFA, key rotation, admin console. NestJS + Next.js + Prisma

paragraphs: A from-scratch OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect identity provider - a "mini Keycloak" built with NestJS, Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL.
Live demo · OAuth playground · Admin console · API reference

Try it in 30 seconds: open the playground, click Sign in with Gatekeeper, log in as demo@gatekeeper.dev / demo1234, approve the consent screen and inspect the verified ID token, access token and protocol trace. Then press Refresh tokens followed by Replay an old refresh token to watch reuse detection revoke the whole token family. The API runs on a free Render instance that sleeps when idle - the first request can take up to a minute (the UI shows a "waking up the server…" screen meanwhile).
features: Authorization Code flow with PKCE required for every client (S256 only), state, nonce, exact redirecturi matching and the RFC 9207 iss response parameter.
prompt=none|login|consent, maxage, consent screen with remembered grants (asks again only for new scopes).
Token endpoint: authorizationcode, refreshtoken with rotation + reuse detection (revokes the whole token family), clientcredentials.
Client authentication: clientsecretbasic, clientsecretpost (secrets stored hashed, shown once), public clients (none + PKCE).
